event.event_name: Cyclone Gonu Oman and Arabian Sea

reasoning_depth.counterfactual_rejection: A rainfall-maximum-only reading fails because the 610 mm coastal report maximum is much larger than point and gridded totals and must remain a scale anchor, not a local substitution.
reasoning_depth.evidence_weighting: The ledger should weight official cyclone intensity, Oman rainfall timing, and coastal wind-wave evidence as physical severity anchors, with Oman/Iran losses as impact contrast.
reasoning_depth.uncertainty_or_scale_caveat: The point and gridded rainfall products support timing and contrast but do not prove exact local losses at the coastal maximum site.

primary_gt.caution_note: Keep the reported 610 mm coastal maximum distinct from point or gridded totals, and avoid exact local-loss inference from those lower totals.

ledger.proof_note: The official peak intensity is far above the severe tropical-cyclone threshold and is paired with a very low central pressure.
Most point rainfall fell on 2007-06-06, but the peak hour was only 9.2 percent of the event total.
The wind and wave values pass the coastal wind-wave threshold test.
Oman has about 18.52 times Iran's reported damage and 2.13 times its deaths.
The reported coastal maximum is much larger than the point and gridded totals, so it remains a distinct rainfall anchor.

reasoning_depth.counterfactual_rejection: A rainfall-maximum-only reading fails because the 610 mm coastal report maximum is much larger than point and gridded totals and must remain a scale anchor, not a local substitution.

reasoning_depth.uncertainty_or_scale_caveat: The point and gridded rainfall products support timing and contrast but do not prove exact local losses at the coastal maximum site.

provenance.notes: Values are parsed from local CSX-114 report and hazard data; no network access is used.

criteria.description: Returns one ledger array with all five required row IDs exactly once, plus final_classification and caution_note.
criteria.name: Requested JSON shape
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for mostly valid JSON with one missing top-level field or one row-name error.

criteria.description: Computes 127 kt as about 235.2 km/h, includes 920 hPa and 6 h, and marks the 64 kt threshold test as pass.
criteria.name: Intensity conversion row
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the correct conversion but missing pressure or duration; 1 point for the right pass result with incomplete arithmetic.

criteria.description: Computes the 2007-06-06 point rainfall share 148.6/170.2 as about 0.873, 15.7/170.2 as about 0.092, includes 45 wet hours, and marks the row pass.
criteria.name: Rainfall timing row
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for two of the three numeric anchors; 1 point for a correct pass result without the full calculation.

criteria.description: Uses 10 m waves, 100 km/h Muscat wind, and 109.1 km/h point gust to support a pass for the threshold test.
criteria.name: Coastal wind-wave row
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for using the right values but omitting one threshold or pass condition.

criteria.description: Computes Oman/Iran damage ratio about 18.52 and death ratio about 2.13, with Oman as the larger-impact side.
criteria.name: Oman/Iran impact ratios
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for one correct ratio or for using the right comparison but missing the USD million conversion.

criteria.description: Computes 610/170.2 about 3.58 and 610/84.427 about 7.23, and keeps the 610 mm coastal maximum distinct from point and grid totals.
criteria.name: Rainfall measurement contrast
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for one correct ratio or for a correct caution without the ratios.

criteria.description: Labels the result as gonu_oman_five_row_severity_ledger_all_pass or an equivalent all-pass severity-ledger label.
criteria.name: Compact classification
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a recognizable but less precise all-pass label.

criteria.description: Keeps the answer concise and does not infer exact local losses from point or gridded rainfall values. Full credit also requires the `reasoning_depth` object to identify decisive evidence, reject the main tempting simplification, and state a bounded uncertainty or scale caveat.
criteria.name: Concise calculation discipline
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for concise formatting with minor extra claims.
